option.counterfactual: The converse implication holds in dimensions two and three but fails in every dimension at least four, so the necessary-dimension set is exactly {2,3}.
option.approach: Revisit the higher-dimensional Fatou–Bieberbach constructions and determine whether their two transverse basin factors can be assembled into holomorphic parameter families. Establishing that stronger property could prove Okaness for the quartic exteriors in dimensions at least four without assuming ordinary Oka coverings suffice.
